lead_headline: Subscriptions net +3 yesterday — best single-day gain in a week — while restaurant tracker flags 5 new leads (openings in Rosedale, Union Station, City Park; closures in West Colfax, Berkeley).

restaurant.blurb: 5 leads today — Openings: Wapos Cantina (Rosedale), Mendocino Farms (Union Station), G-Que BBQ (Union Station). Closures: Powered By Besitos food truck (West Colfax), New Dragon (Berkeley temp closed after fire).

foreclosure.blurb: One $15 million filing scheduled for July 31 auction in Weld County.

liquor.blurb: 8 applications filed Tuesday as post-drought momentum continues. Restaurant permits dominate: Senor Tanuki (Brighton Blvd), Yoshi (17th Ave), Benihana Express (16th St Mall) all pending hotel/restaurant licenses. Mynt tavern-cabaret at 117 Broadway and Bakery Four beer/wine at Tennyson both already cleared to active status. Peak Sim Racking seeks beer/wine permit for Broadway location, M&A Demoz files for Quebec Street tasting room, Cruise Room/Starbucks combo targets DIA concourse AM-2. Second consecutive 8-application day after 11-day July freeze ended Monday — August opening at accelerated pace.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Tuesday — consecutive blank days now stretch media drought into third day. Seven-day window holds at 6 total mentions across 5 sources, down 93% from prior week's 80. Instagram (2 citations) led recent activity, Building Salt Lake covered Alterra ski HQ consideration, Denver Post reported Fire on the Mountain expansion. Week's 0.9 mentions/day average remains lowest sustained rate since tracking launch. If silence extends through Wednesday, August's opening week will mark unprecedented media quiet period — current pace projects to ~4 mentions for full week vs. typical 60-80.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +3 yesterday (6 new, 3 canceled) — strongest single-day gain since July 31 — lifts MTD to +3 (+0.8/day), 90-day net rises to +102. Tuesday's performance breaks four-day pattern of churn (+1, −1, +1, +0) and suggests August momentum building after volatile late July. Seven-day window now shows +14 net (28 new, 14 canceled), down from prior week's +27 but holding steady above midsummer lows. Recent two-week stretch demonstrates stabilization: last 14 days averaged +1.2/day vs. +1.0/day YTD baseline. If Tuesday's +3 pace sustains through week, MTD could reach +15-20 range by Sunday — meaningful reversal from July's closing weakness. Annual net holds at +219 (+1.0/day).
